definition: A cold, sweet treat made from milk and sugar.

options.text: A crunchy snack made from corn
A cold, sweet treat made from milk

explanation: Ice cream is a cold treat that melts in the sun. Yum!

definition: A place where people grow flowers, fruits or vegetables.

options.text: A place where flowers and vegetables grow

explanation: In a garden, people grow plants. Great job!

definition: To speak very softly so only a person close by can hear.
example: I had to whisper in the library.

options.text: To shout as loudly as you can

explanation: When you whisper, you use a very quiet voice. Well done!

definition: The room where food is made.

options.text: The room where food is made
The room where you take a bath

options.text: A drawing or photo that shows something

definition: Paying close attention so that nothing bad happens.

options.text: Paying close attention to stay safe
